lines: Snappy! Manners! Sorry. I'm Bramble.
I was down in the roots back home. Then... the sky.
Everyone's watching us. Roots don't like being watched.
There you are! The whole hive's humming about you.
Can I come with you? I'll be right behind you. Or under you!
On soft ground, press {burrow} and we'll burrow!
Yay! Press {friend} when you need me!
That's OK! I'll ask again another time.
Still want me along?
Yay! Press {friend} when you need me!
That's OK! I'll ask again another time.
{player}! Pip says you can glow now! PERFECT!
There are caves under my garden. Too dark for me.
The way in is the root-ringed hole on the hill.
Something big is snoring down there. Could you go see?
Find four glowing spores down in the Undergardens!
The Old Taproot is AWAKE? And he gave you Glowcaps!
Plant them! They glow all night.
The old slide? The plants don't like to talk about it.
There's a green glow by the Haunted House at night.
Rights for dogs? Of course! I love Rook.
(Snappy tries to eat the pen!)
{player}! I waited so long a butterfly landed on me!
The south meadow's blooming tonight! You have to see it!
And there's a glowy blue paper out there. A schematic!
Oh! Hello! Sorry about the dirt.
I'm Bramble. I grow things. This is Snappy.
Snappy, manners! He only eats bugs. And socks.
Mr. Palmer wants flowers in every window box!
Would you fill the boxes for me?
Hooray! Here's an armful!
Stars on your map show where!
No rush!
Fill the five window boxes!
{player}: All the window boxes are full!
I felt them bloom, all the way down in my roots!
I did the rest of the town too! Thank you!
Every window's got flowers now!
The bees are SO happy.
{player}: What would you want a mayor to do?
Flowers in every window box!
{player}, seen the glowing green crystals round the Void?
They're Remnants. Roots of time!
With the right tool, I can dig them out.
And there's a patch by my greenhouse for YOUR garden!
Hooray! We need three things. Stars on your map!
That's all right!
Shall we make that digging tool?
Yay! Find the three parts. Stars on your map!
Okay! No rush.

rotate: They glow a little. Look for a light!
The roots say the parts are still out there.

lines: {player}: I found all three parts!
Oh, the crystal's humming! It's excited!
What should it look like? You choose!
(A Leafy Trowel!)
(A Crystal Pick!)
(A Star Scoop!)
Your own {tool}! Use it on a glowing vein. There's one by the lake.
Use your tool on a glowing vein! I'll pop up.
Welcome to your garden!
Plant a seed, then water it!

rotate: Drooping? It's thirsty! Give it water.
The plants say your garden's their favourite!
Use your {tool} on a vein and I'll pop up!
The Fruit stall buys your crops!

lines: The portal's open! The flowers glow brighter.
Morning! Everything grows happier today.
Roots hold you up, even when you can't see them.
Fresh flowers! Some are my cousins.
A flower for you!
Watch the ground!
(She dives in and pops up again!) Ta-daa!
Watering time! Everyone gets a drink.
Morning! Me and the flowers do our stretches.
Shh, the plants are sleeping.
{player}: (whispering) Goodnight, plants.

rotate: Snappy missed a firefly. He's still learning!
You look tired. Want a pick-me-up?

lines: (Tiny flowers pop up round your feet!)
Fresh as a daisy!
Alright! Knock on the ground if you need me.

rotate: Feeling wobbly? Think of your roots. Your friends. Your home.
Melody sings to my flowers every evening.
Sit in the grass a minute. It helps!
